title: Hybrid search: primary lexical decode errors fail the request, enrichment decode errors fail open
answers: Why does hybrid search return an error instead of just skipping a bad row?
Should managed-by/folder-title lookup failures fail the whole search?
What's the error-handling convention for new hybrid search enrichment lookups?
body:
Symptom: hybrid search either fails hard on any malformed field, or silently drops managed-by/folder-title info depending on which leg hit the problem.
Root cause: decoded search values are `any`-typed; a schema mismatch can't be safely ignored for the primary results, but optional enrichment data was always allowed to be incomplete.
Fix pattern: the lexical leg (pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_hybrid.go:hybridLexicalLeg) wraps decode errors from lexicalHitsFromResponse and returns them, failing the whole HybridSearch call. resolveManagedBy and resolveFolderTitles (same file) instead log a Warn and return on decode error, leaving those fields empty — same pattern already used for the searchCallError check on these two calls.
Constraints: apply this split to any new enrichment lookup added to hybrid search: primary data path propagates decode/format errors, best-effort enrichment paths log and continue without failing the request.
says: Hybrid search fails completely when encountering a malformed field
Why does one bad row break the entire search?
Missing folder title shouldn't fail the whole search request
How should enrichment lookup failures affect hybrid search results?
search: Hybrid search (pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_hybrid.go) distinguishes between primary and enrichment data paths: lexical leg failures propagate decode errors and fail the entire HybridSearch call; enrichment lookups (resolveManagedBy, resolveFolderTitles) log Warn and return on decode error without failing the request. Constraint: apply this split consistently to any new enrichment lookup — primary data path must propagate decode/format errors as critical, best-effort enrichment paths log and continue. This prevents optional managed-by and folder-title info from breaking the core search results when schema mismatches occur. Applies when implementing hybrid search or adding new enrichment data sources.
